title: Write website articles for search traffic with agents
summary: An SEO agency founder built Claude writing agents for a game site; the team reports 750 indexed pages, and the tool now writes for 40+ businesses.
agent_role: One agent researches keywords and another writes designed pages. Humans read every article and fed hundreds of edits back into a 25-check review process.
outcome: The author reports keyword-to-page in 10 to 15 minutes, 2,500 users in one day on the test site, and use by 40+ businesses.
what_they_did: An SEO agency founder, Steven, started building a writing agent in Claude for his video game site. His partner read every article and complained about flaws. Those hundreds of edits became a 25-check review list. They split the work into a research agent built on agency know-how and a writing agent that uses each client's voice and proof.
how_it_went: The author says the test site got 750 pages indexed and 2,500 users in a single day. They report a keyword becomes a designed page in 10 to 15 minutes, and the tool now writes for 40+ businesses.
worth_knowing: The author credits the quality to a picky human reviewer, not the tool. The feedback loop of hundreds of edits is what made the output usable.
prompt: Act as a writer for my website [site URL] about [topic]. For the keyword [keyword], research what top pages cover and what readers ask. Draft an article in my brand voice, using these real examples and facts: [your proof points]. Then check the draft against my quality list: [your checks, e.g. no filler, specific examples, clear headings]. Show me the draft and the checklist results, and wait for my edits before I publish anything.

curation.rationale: A real agent story with numbers (750 pages, 2,500 users a day, 40+ clients), but it is partly a product pitch and gives few reproducible details.
